title: Chadillac Adventures

services.name: Rental
services.desc: Ready for an unforgettable day on the water? We offer kayak, tandem kayak, paddleboard, and canoe rentals from two fantastic Pinellas County locations: Clearwater Beach and Cove Cay Marina. For an iconic Florida experience, choose our Clearwater Beach kayak rental or Clearwater Beach paddleboard rental. Explore the stunning Gulf waters, paddle past famous sugar-sand beaches, and potentially spot local marine life. Our convenient Clearwater Beach location puts you right in the heart of the action. services.name: Night Kayaking
services.desc: If you’re coming to Clearwater Beach, you’ve got to get out on the water. What better way than our clear kayak tours at an affordable price? Paddle through the Intracoastal waters near Clearwater Beach toward the spoil islands and sandbar. It’s an easy paddle, 2-3 hours long, and we keep it laid-back with our professional guides. First-timers, families, couples-everyone does great! We will set the kayaks on “cruise control,” explore, and even hop out and swim, enjoying everything Clearwater Beach has to offer from a kayak.
